text: Scaled dot product attention is the heart of the transformer, and it's four lines of PyTorch.
We import torch, and that's the only dependency.
The function takes Q, K and V — query, key and value.
d_k is the size of the last dimension, the width of each vector.
Q at K transposed is a matrix of dot products, every query against every key.
That dot product is the similarity score, how much each token should attend to each other token.
We divide by the square root of d_k to stop those scores growing with dimension.
Without that scaling, softmax saturates and the gradients vanish.
Softmax turns each row of scores into weights that sum to one.
Then weights at V takes a weighted average of the values.
Six tokens, eight dimensions each, and the output comes back the same shape.
That's attention, the piece everything else in the transformer is built on. Comment if you want multi-head next.
